0.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_000
0.description: I don't know you. Why have you come to Radiata?

3.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_A1_000_002
3.description: What kind of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_010
5.description: Tell you about myself...? You really are a stranger here, aren't you. Too much talk can get a person killed.

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_011
6.description: My father talked too much once─complained about his job. A “friend” reported him to the authorities, and then the soldiers came to take him away as a “suspected insurgent.” I never saw him again.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_012
7.description: And then there was my little brother. When a group of patriots heard he was a laborer for the Empire, they strung him up from a tree.<hex:02100103>So, no─you don't talk about yourself around here.

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_013
8.description: There's not much to tell. I'm Leaping Doe─I live here.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_014
9.description: I could probably pack up and move somewhere else now that the imperials are gone, but I guess I've just been here too long. I've a mind to stay a while anyway, just in case my father ever comes back...

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_015
10.description: Now that we don't need to live in fear every day, Radiata's not such a bad place to be.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_020
11.description: Radiata? Well, this village is home to those who labor at Castrum Abania or Specula Imperatoris. Think of it as an imperial slave pen.

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_021
12.description: It certainly wasn't called “Radiata” by the folk who live here. It had a different name once, but you'll not hear anyone say it out loud. That earns you a visit from the correction officers.

13.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_022
13.description: You tell other villagers you're from Radiata, though, and it'll get you spit on. To everyone else, we're the Empire's “whipped curs.”

14.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_023
14.description: We lose either way. If we're to be treated like dogs for where we were born, then we've no choice but to live like one...

15.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_024
15.description: This village is home to those who were forced to labor at Castrum Abania or Specula Imperatoris. That's all changed now, of course.

16.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_025
16.description: The imperials have lost any hold they had here, aside from the name they gave the place. It did have another, once upon a time, but I guess everyone is too used to “Radiata” to bother switching it back.

17.name: TEXT_REGGYR3RADIATA_00400_LEAPINGDOE_000_026
17.description: Hells, I don't think even a single person has left the place. Perhaps the idea of freedom hasn't sunk in yet─gotta remember what it's like to stretch your wings before you can fly away.
